title: myself/yourself/themselves etc.
summary: Возвратные местоимения **myself, himself, themselves** (действие направлено на себя), выражения **by myself** и **each other**.
ru:
## Что это такое
Когда человек делает действие **с самим собой**, после глагола ставим возвратное местоимение на **-self / -selves**. В русском это «-ся» или «себя».
> He cut **himself** with a knife. — Он порезался ножом.
> I looked at **myself** in the mirror. — Я посмотрела на себя в зеркало.
> Be careful. Don't hurt **yourself**. — Осторожно, не поранься.

## Таблица
- I → **myself**
- you (один) → **yourself**
- he → **himself**
- she → **herself**
- it → **itself**
- we → **ourselves**
- you (несколько) → **yourselves**
- they → **themselves**

## me или myself?
- **me, him, them** — это **другой** человек: *You never talk to **me**. — Ты никогда не говоришь со мной.*
- **myself, himself, themselves** — **тот же** человек, что и подлежащее: *I talk to **myself**. — Я говорю сам с собой.*

## Устойчивые выражения
- **Help yourself!** — Угощайтесь! (берите сами)
- **Enjoy yourself! / We enjoyed ourselves.** — Приятно провести время / Мы хорошо провели время.
- **by myself / by yourself** = **один, без помощи**: *I went on holiday **by myself**. — Я поехала в отпуск одна.*

## each other — друг друга
**each other** используем, когда двое (или больше) делают одно и то же друг с другом.
> Jill and Ann know **each other** well. — Джилл и Энн хорошо знают друг друга.
> Steve and Sue looked at **each other**. — Стив и Сью посмотрели друг на друга.
> Steve and Sue looked at **themselves**. — Стив и Сью посмотрели на самих себя (каждый на себя, например, в зеркало).

## Когда НЕ нужно -self
В английском некоторые глаголы уже подразумевают «себя»: **wash, shave, dress, relax** — не добавляйте -self.
> I **washed** and got dressed. (не ~~washed myself~~)
> He **shaved** and left. (не ~~shaved himself~~)

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She hurt her.~~ → She hurt **herself**.
- ~~They enjoyed theirselves.~~ → They enjoyed **themselves**.
- ~~Help you!~~ → Help **yourself**!
- ~~They looked at themselves (друг на друга).~~ → They looked at **each other**.
en:
## Reflexive pronouns
When the subject and the object are the **same person**, we use **-self / -selves**.
> He cut **himself** with a knife.
> I looked at **myself** in the mirror.
> Don't hurt **yourself**.

## The list
- I → **myself**
- you (one) → **yourself**
- he → **himself**
- she → **herself**
- it → **itself**
- we → **ourselves**
- you (more than one) → **yourselves**
- they → **themselves**

## me or myself?
- **me, him, them** = a different person: *You never talk to **me**.*
- **myself, himself, themselves** = the same person: *I talk to **myself**.*

## Useful phrases
- **Help yourself!** — Take what you want.
- **We enjoyed ourselves.** — We had a good time.
- **by myself** = alone: *I went on holiday **by myself**.*

## each other
We use **each other** when two people do the same thing to one another.
> Jill and Ann know **each other** well.
> Steve and Sue looked at **each other**. (he looked at her, she looked at him)
> Steve and Sue looked at **themselves**. (each looked at himself or herself)

## No -self needed
We don't use -self with **wash, shave, dress, relax**.
> I **washed** and got dressed.

## Common mistakes
- ~~She hurt her.~~ → She hurt **herself**.
- ~~They enjoyed theirselves.~~ → They enjoyed **themselves**.
structure:
## Таблица
| Подлежащее | Возвратное |
|---|---|
| I | myself |
| you (ед.) | yourself |
| he | himself |
| she | herself |
| it | itself |
| we | ourselves |
| you (мн.) | yourselves |
| they | themselves |

## Формулы
> Подлежащее + глагол + **-self / -selves**
> She cut **herself**. · We enjoyed **ourselves**.

> **by** + -self = «один, сам»
> I live **by myself**. · He did it **by himself**.

> A and B + глагол + **each other**
> Tom and Ann love **each other**.

## Правила
- **himself**, **themselves** — не ~~hisself~~, ~~theirselves~~.
- Единственное число: **-self**, множественное: **-selves**.
- Глаголы **wash, dress, shave, relax, meet, feel** обычно без -self.

exercises.title: myself, yourself ...
exercises.example: He looks at *him* in the mirror → He looks at **himself** in the mirror.

items.text: I looked at {{myself}} in the mirror.
She fell off her bike, but she didn't hurt {{herself}}.
He cut {{himself}} while he was cooking.
We had a good holiday. We enjoyed {{ourselves}}.
The children are playing. They are enjoying {{themselves}}.
Please help {{yourself}}, Ann. There is a lot of food.
Please help {{yourselves}}, everybody. There is a lot of food.

exercises.title: me / him / them или myself / himself / themselves?
exercises.instruction: Выберите нужное слово и впишите его.

items.text: Don't look at {{me}}! I'm not ready.
He is looking at {{himself}} in the mirror.
She is looking at {{him}}. He is her brother.
I'm very proud of {{myself}}. I passed the exam!
Tom and Sue love {{each other}}.
They paid for {{themselves}}. Nobody helped them.
Why are you angry with {{me}}? I didn't do anything.

exercises.title: by myself
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **by myself, by yourself, by himself, by herself, by ourselves, by themselves**.

items.text: I went to the cinema {{by myself}}. Nobody came with me.
She lives {{by herself}} in a small flat.
Did you do your homework {{by yourself}}?
He built this house {{by himself}}.
We cleaned the whole house {{by ourselves}}.
The children made lunch {{by themselves}}.
